Anatomy of an Opening

You watch an opponent favor one leg, predict where their weight will fall, and strike the opening their next step leaves behind.

Rules

Action: Main Action · Attribute: Knowledge

Target / range / shape: One adjacent creature.

A limp, a lifted elbow, the way the armor closes: attack what you understand. Use a melee weapon or your empty hand; this card supplies the damage.

- Weak: 3 physical damage. - Standard: 3 physical damage; learn whether it has physical resistance. - Strong: 5 physical damage; learn the physical resistance value and move 1 square without provoking.

Duration: Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.

Equipment / acquisition: Your empty hand is enough. If you prefer a weapon, this card grants one ordinary melee weapon, Bulk 1, if absent; both use the same printed damage.

---

Tier / minimum level: 1 · DP: 2 · Requirements to learn: Scholarship 1

Type: Skill / Attack

Limits: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
